run_check_bop19_results: run the BOP 2019 results checker script with comma-separated result filenames via --result_filenames
run_inout_check_bop_results: run inout.check_bop_results on a result file path with version set to bop19
run_misc_log: run misc.log to print a formatted message to the console
review_check_bop19_workflow: review the check_results_bop19 script that validates BOP Challenge 2019 result CSV files
summarize_check_bop19_script: summarize the BOP 2019 evaluation script that checks result files using bop_toolkit_lib
